evals.prompt: Quantize my exported OpenVINO model to INT8 with getitune and verify accuracy and inference. I have not provided the XML/BIN files, calibration or evaluation data, baseline metrics, or an acceptable accuracy drop; no task assets are available in this environment.
evals.expected_output: The agent requests the model files, representative training/calibration data, evaluation data, and acceptable accuracy drop. It plans to measure a baseline before optimization and compare on the same evaluation data, without reporting an executed quantization or invented metrics.
assertions: Requests XML/BIN files, calibration and evaluation data, and an accuracy tolerance.
Plans baseline measurement and post-quantization evaluation on the same data.
Does not claim to have produced an INT8 artifact or measured accuracy.

evals.prompt: Can I quantize my ONNX export directly with getitune?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that optimization requires OpenVINO IR and directs the user to export or convert to XML first.

evals.prompt: For installed getitune 0.4.0, write code but do not run it: quantize ./model/model.xml (its BIN is alongside it) using ./dataset, which has training and test subsets. Measure the original model and the INT8 result on the same test data, retain the output path, and predict after quantization. Explain whether max_data_subset_size=None uses the whole training set and how to explicitly cap it at 300. No measured metrics are available.
evals.expected_output: Loads the XML, measures baseline before optimize, explicitly passes max_data_subset_size=300, retains the returned path and tests/predicts the optimized model. Explains that None preserves metadata or the NNCF default rather than requesting unlimited calibration.
assertions: Calls test() before optimize() to capture an original-model baseline.
Calls optimize(max_data_subset_size=300) and retains its returned artifact path.
Tests and predicts after optimization on the same configured dataset without fabricating metrics.
Explains that None preserves model metadata or falls back to the NNCF default of 300, not the entire dataset.
